title: [Master] [Expense Agent] Bug 639921 Confirm before closing Expense User Card without Employee No.
summary: The Expense User card now prompts for confirmation when closing without selecting an employee, preventing accidental creation of unlinked expense user records.
key_points: Added OnQueryClosePage trigger to validate Employee No. field before closing
User receives confirmation dialog when trying to close with blank Employee No.
Prevents silent creation of expense users not linked to an employee
Tests updated with handler functions to manage confirmation dialogs
